name: io.github.Milan344s/ai-crawlability-check
title: AI Crawlability Check
description: Check if AI crawlers like GPTBot and ClaudeBot can reach, index and quote any web page.

tools.name: check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Reports which AI crawlers may fetch a public URL. Reads the site's robots.txt and returns allowed or blocked, with the deciding rule, for each known AI crawler from OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Meta, Amazon and others, split into search and answer-time bots versus training bots. Also checks whether the server answers an automated request, noindex and nosnippet directives, declared sitemaps, Content-Signal lines and llms.txt. Use for "are we blocking GPTBot or ClaudeBot?", "can ChatGPT read this page?" or an AI crawler audit of robots.txt.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to check, for example https://example.com/pricing.

tools.name: check_ai_indexability
tools.description: Checks whether a public page can be indexed by search and AI engines once a crawler reaches it. Measures HTTP status and redirects, noindex, canonical target, how much copy exists in the raw HTML without JavaScript, client-side rendering signals, title and H1, XML sitemap coverage, response time, HTML size, structured data validity, dates and language. Use for "why is this page not showing up in ChatGPT or Perplexity?", "is this page indexable?" or to check a JavaScript-rendered page. It does not query any index.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to check, for example https://example.com/pricing.

tools.name: check_ai_citability
tools.description: Fetches a public page and scores how quotable its content is for AI engines once it is crawled and indexed. Measures answer-first structure, question headings, lists and tables, FAQ, paragraph and sentence length, statistic and source density, named entities, schema, author, freshness and llms.txt, plus a short crawler-access summary. Use for "will AI cite this page?", "is this article LLM-friendly?" or a GEO check. Tuned for articles and guides.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to check, for example https://example.com/pricing.

tools.name: check_seo_basics
tools.description: Fetches a public page and runs 24 measurable on-page SEO checks: title and meta description length, H1, heading hierarchy, keyword placement and density, slug, canonical, internal and external links, anchor text, image alt text, schema and social tags. Pass the target keyword to enable the keyword checks. Does not cover rankings or backlinks.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to check, for example https://example.com/pricing.

keyword.description: Target keyword or phrase. Optional; without it the keyword checks are skipped.

tools.name: get_review_rubric
tools.description: Returns a scoring rubric as text for the judgment items the URL tools cannot measure: geo (would an AI engine quote this article?) or seo (pre-publish SEO review). Fetches nothing.
